_doc: Task 6K.1 section 5. Cropped-tile -> whole-image mapping recovery and VALIDATION. The mapping is not assumed: each sampled cropped image tile is compared pixel-by-pixel with the corresponding whole-image window (RGB identity), each sampled cropped label tile with the whole-label window (exact or both empty), and the native vector clipped to the same window is compared with the label window.

conclusion.mapping_confidence: validated (pixel identity on the sampled tiles + exact grid capacity)
